body:
docs/STALWART_GCP_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md answers the 5 real open deployment questions EMAIL_NORTHSTAR.md already named: dedicated GCP infra (not the shared box, to isolate mail-port spam/blocklist risk), SQLite storage backend, IDUNA auth deferred to v1, staff-provisioned-only v0 (no public self-signup, closes the abuse-policy gap for free), flat per-mailbox quota. Real GCP architecture: e2-small Compute Engine VM, static IP, PTR-record request (named as an easy-to-miss GCP-specific step), Stalwart's own built-in ACME/DNS auto-publish. Real 4-phase rollout (GCP foundation -> install+DNS -> real end-to-end send/receive proof with DKIM/SPF/DMARC verified -> IDUNA/self-signup deferred). Plan only -- no GCP project, no DNS, no VM. Commit dd7f544.

⚓ ☃
title: CPBOOT-002: Stalwart-on-GCP deployment plan
